captions.caption: An F-35 fighter jet is parked on the airfield with a ground crew member signaling nearby.
The F-35's engine is running as the ground crew member continues giving hand signals.
The F-35 begins to taxi forward slowly on the concrete airfield.
The ground crew member observes as the F-35 continues its initial taxi movement.
The F-35 turns its nose wheel slightly while taxiing on the tarmac.
The F-35 continues to move forward, its navigation lights visible.
The F-35 taxis past the camera, showing the "HL" marking on its tail.
The F-35 moves further away, continuing its taxi toward the runway.
The rear of the F-35 is seen as it taxis along the marked airfield lines.
The ground crew member stands still as the F-35 taxis into the distance.
The F-35 continues its taxi, heading toward a group of parked aircraft.
Heat haze from the F-35's engine is visible as it moves away.
The F-35 completes its turn and continues taxiing down the airfield.
The scene fades as the F-35 moves further away on the tarmac.
Ground crew members are seen working near the nose of an F-15 fighter jet.
Personnel in military uniforms conduct pre-flight checks on the F-15.
A pilot is visible inside the open cockpit of the F-15 as ground crew work below.
The ground crew continues their maintenance activities around the F-15.
Two F-15 fighter jets are parked on the tarmac with personnel moving around them.
Ground crew members walk between two parked F-15s on the airfield.
Heat haze and engine noise indicate that the parked F-15s are powered on.
The F-15s remain stationary as ground operations continue in the background.
Personnel are seen working near the support equipment parked by the F-15s.
A wider shot shows several F-15s lined up on the airfield with active ground crew.
Close-up of an F-15 with ground crew members performing final checks.
A crew member kneels near the main landing gear of the F-15.
The F-15 sits on the tarmac with its canopy open and crew nearby.
Ground crew personnel are active around the front fuselage of the F-15.
The F-15 remains parked as ground operations continue before taxiing.
An F-35 taxis along the airfield, passing several parked F-15s.
The F-35 moves steadily from left to right across the tarmac.
The F-35 continues its taxi, with F-15s and hangars visible in the background.
The F-35 moves further along the taxiway, its engine noise audible.
A blue pickup truck is parked near the taxiway as the F-35 passes.
The F-35 taxis past the camera, showing its sleek gray fuselage.
The F-35 continues its movement on the tarmac, following the yellow lines.
More parked F-15s come into view as the F-35 taxis past them.
The F-35 passes a row of parked fighter jets on the airfield.
The F-35 moves towards the right side of the screen, continuing its taxi.
The jet's tail markings are visible as it moves away from the camera.
The F-35 continues to taxi, heading towards the end of the line of aircraft.
The F-35 moves further into the background of the airfield.
The aircraft continues its steady taxi, passing various ground equipment.
The F-35 taxis out of the main frame as it moves down the runway.
The shot transitions to a view of F-15s lined up on the taxiway.
A blue pickup truck drives across the airfield in front of parked F-15s.
The first F-15 in the queue begins to taxi forward on the tarmac.
The F-15 turns onto the main taxiway, following the yellow markings.
The F-15 continues its turn, revealing the "SJ" marking on its tail.
The F-15 taxis past the camera, its engines producing a loud roar.
The F-15 moves steadily along the concrete taxiway toward the runway.
The side profile of the F-15 is visible as it taxis past the viewer.
The F-15 continues its taxi movement, heading towards the right.
The rear section of the first F-15 passes out of the frame.
A second F-15 begins to taxi forward from its parking position.
The second F-15 moves forward to join the sequence of taxiing jets.
The second F-15 starts its turn onto the main taxiway.
A third F-15 is seen starting its taxi in the distance behind the second one.
The second F-15 continues its taxi as the third one moves forward.
Multiple F-15 fighter jets are now seen taxiing in a line on the airfield.
